about: Who the outer road's people and animals are and what they do: every painted figure and animal of S4 part 1 (map/text/S4.md, u 9400-12600) at its mapped spot (layout.json), and nobody else (map/BUILDING.md). Written by gen/sections/outer_road/make_people.py (the casting of gen/expand/outer_road_needs.md and the lead's calls of 2026-10-12); rerun it when the workshop delivers characters, clips and props. figures: character (a new one plays its stand_in until it exists), do = [clip, seconds] cycles with clips the playing character has (clips_why: what is still to make), nudge = [dX, dD] (nudge_why), facing_deg where the map gives none (facing_why), scale for children (scale_why), ride = the animal a rider sits on, props = carried prop_<name> parts (props_why). walkers: figures painted mid-stride or carrying a load, walking along their painted direction from their spot and back (walkers_why). animals: each painted animal at its map position facing hind to fore, model and load from web/public/assets/animals/animals.json (horse_white, bird and the pannier_charcoal load are being made: the page skips them until then). No traffic.

nudge_why.shopkeeper_10425: painted behind his tray stand, but his foot point lies in front of it (the builder stands the stand at D 24.43-24.83, X 16.6-17.0); he stands just behind it, inside the shop's open front

nudge_why.groom_rider_10255: painted against the rider's horse's flank: his spot is 0.32 m from its centre line, inside the real-size horse (half-width 0.33 m), so he steps 0.24 m straight out to stand against the flank, on the side he is painted

nudge_why.man_beside_porter_11066: only his face shows, above the slatted box, and his spot is 0.12 m from its centre; he stands just behind (north of) it, where the painting hides his body

nudge_why.onlooker_hat_12084: stands 0.36 m from the gesturing man on the map; each steps 0.08 m aside so their bodies do not overlap
nudge_why.onlooker_gesturing_12112: stands 0.36 m from the man in the dark hat on the map; each steps 0.08 m aside so their bodies do not overlap

animals_why.models: species as painted (map/text/S4.md): 5 oxen, 3 horses (the fan rider's, the dark one held by the groom, the white one lying in the courier post's yard: horse_white), 4 donkeys, 4 pigs and a small black bird in the big willow (bird)
animals_why.teams: S5's covered cart's three oxen (ox_shaft_9972, ox_far_10045, ox_lead_10235; the gate builder's harness reaches to their map spots) and the second cart's two (ox_shaft_10712, ox_lead_10872) stand in their harness with an idle; none walks on the spot, and none is nudged, since each cart's harness is built to their map spots
animals_why.loads: the fan rider's horse carries a saddle (hidden behind the groom and the cart in the painting; the rider sits on it); the three pack donkeys carry the wicker pannier frames heaped with dark lumpy goods (pannier_charcoal); the grey donkey, the dark horse, the white horse and the pigs carry nothing painted
animals_why.doing: the head-down ones graze (the grey donkey, the east pack donkey, the dark horse, the rooting pig); the fan rider's horse, painted with its head hanging low, lowers it now and then; the white horse lies; the pack donkeys stand and root on the spot
animals_why.pigs: the pig herd is painted walking east along the top road: each pig walks 3.2 m along its painted heading and back (lead, 2026-10-12)
animals_why.perched: the bird sits 9.5 m up in the big willow (layout H, support perched; the page places a perched animal at its H)

clips_why.about: Actions the painting needs that the playing character lacks. "being made": the workshop has it in the character's characters/<name>.json; "to make": nobody has it for that character yet (NEW: a new action; otherwise a retarget of an existing motion). Rerun make_people.py when they land; until then each figure plays the nearest clip its character, or stand-in, has.

notes.hold_child: the woman plays hold_child with prop_child_in_arms, and her child (child_in_arms_10430) is carried_by her: the page draws it as her prop, so it has no body of its own (the lead, 2026-10-12)
notes.seats: fortune_teller_12232 (tell_fortune, sit) and ox_driver_seated_9815 (sit, drive_cart) play chair sits with no seat mapped under them (map: "feet est under the table"; the driver sits on the front of S5's cart's shafts, H 0.9); map/BUILDING.md rule 3 makes a painted-seated figure's seat part of it, and no builder makes these yet, so they sit on air until one does (the driver's: the gate builder's cart, whose draught pole passes under him; people.js stands his feet on whatever is under his foot point). soldier_on_stool_11630 sits on the mapped stool beside him (nudge_why)
